top_band: light yellow straw top surface across rows 3-7 (with row 2 top outline) above the row 8 horizontal divider
evidence: Reading down column 6: row 2 is the back outline, rows 3-7 (5 rows) form a lighter yellow horizontal top band, row 8 is a distinct darker brown front-edge seam, and rows 9-14 (6 rows) form the darker ochre vertical front face.

style.evidence: The bale uses only 5 colours in total: 3 body tones plus 1 uniform olive-brown outline for the hay, and a single unshaded flat brown pixel column (rows 3-14) for the central rope that does not even change value between the top and front faces. The front face relies on a mechanical 1x1 checkerboard dither instead of organic straw clusters, making it look much flatter and simpler than the Beodeul reference props.
